why: A path, procedural figure or art bible is NOT a realistic character model. Every face/body/rig must physically exist and render in Unreal before it counts.
sourceAuthority: Original 1987 MSX2 cast and visible identity + art direction compatible with MGS4/MGSV quality; later media not a source of 1995 plot events.

creationTechnology.recommended: In-Unreal MetaHuman Creator for individual human characters, assembled Cine/High fidelity heads + body mesh; original bespoke clothing/grooms; actor-specific face capture and physical animation.
creationTechnology.availability: Requires Unreal Editor 5.7 MetaHuman plugin and user-authored/imported assets; cannot be created merely by C++ references.

legal: Do not rip Konami meshes/VO, imitate copyrighted screen captures as editable assets or claim character names/likeness licence for public release.
qualityGates: Approved 1995 facial reference sheet with source confidence
Distinct anatomically credible facial sculpt for each named character
Actually imported skeletal body with rig+LODs and original costume
PBR materials on head/body/clothing/hair, corrective morphs for shoulders/face
Full facial blink, jaw/visemes, eyes/lip sync tested against recorded VO
Weapon right-hand socket, foot placement, physical cloth/hair, head tracking
UE5.7 in-editor screenshot/sequence at 1080p+ with no proxy visible
Legal provenance record for all source assets; render/performance capture tested
